'''Eriz Vossan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was one of the best cultural explorers that served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He fell into the sickness of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Parkanas Tark|Vivicar]] until he was later cured by a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
During the [[Great Galactic War]], Master Vossan went on a mission to [[Malachor III]] along with [[Sidonie Garen]], [[Yuon Par]], [[Cin Tykan]], [[Duras Fain]], and [[Parkanas Tark]]. However, during their mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Vossan and the Jedi Masters uncovered some terrible [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|evil]] and were nearly affected by it. As they tried to escape, Vossan fell behind until Parkanas Tark saved him, but became trapped in the process and was left behind by the other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Eriz believed that it was his fault for leaving his friend behind.

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Master Eriz went to the desert planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While he was exploring and tried to learn more about the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]], he fell to the plague of Lord Vivicar, who was in fact his friend Parkanas. Upon discovering a carving depicting Tatooine's early history, he concluded that the Sand People were the ultimate warriors, the plague influencing him to take on a survival of the fittest philosophy to build an army for the "coming darkness". Fortunately, he was healed by an aspiring [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]], being spared from the plague.
